name: imshow
expr: imshow(I); y1 = max(I(:)); imshow(J, [10 35]); y2 = min(J(:)); imshow(J, []); y3 = max(J(:)); imshow(uint8([0 64 128; 192 255 128; 0 128 255])); imshow(RGB); rgbsz = size(RGB); rgb1 = RGB(1,1,1); rgb2 = RGB(2,2,3);
comment: imshow is a display-only builtin — no scalar return. Probes set up canonical inputs (grayscale double, explicit/empty range, uint8, RGB via cat(3,...)), then read derived scalars from the SAME inputs to fingerprint that the calls didn't alter the workspace. correctness=OK confirms imshow runs in MATLAB / numkit / Octave without error and the inputs survived intact. Display fidelity (range, colormap, axis off) is covered by the gtest in libs/graphics/tests/figure_test.cpp + the e2e in ide/desktop/tests/e2e/imshow.spec.js.
